tenses_found: present perfect continuous (we've been waiting, we've been wanting)
first conditional (if I get another speeding ticket, they'll take my license)
reported speech (it specifically said... that they had to be)
grammatical_complexity.notes: Dominated by simple tenses in dialogue, but present perfect continuous, first conditional, wish structure, past perfect, and reported speech appear as a noticeable minority. Complex structures are scattered throughout rather than concentrated.

cultural_reference_load.notes: Mostly universal travel concepts familiar to any LatAm adult. AirBnB and Uber are globally known. Customs and vaccination requirements are universally understood post-Covid. No North American-specific customs that would impede comprehension.

sentence_structure.notes: Predominantly short dialogue utterances with simple subject-verb-object patterns. Some compound sentences with conjunctions. A few longer narrative sentences in stage directions. Overall very accessible sentence structure.
